# GridPaw

GridPaw is a free online platform for cat-themed logic puzzle games. Three games in one hub:

## Shikaku (Rectangle Partition)
Play at https://gridpaw.com
Drag to draw rectangles on a numbered grid. Each rectangle must cover exactly the number of cells shown. Classic Nikoli puzzle with cute cat visuals.

## Akari (Light Up)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/akari/
Place glowing cats to light up every cell. Numbered walls tell you how many adjacent cats are needed. Pure logic, no guessing.

## Kakuro (Cross Sums)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/kakuro/
Fill runs so they sum to their clues with no repeated digits. Features a 4-step tutorial, an 11-level campaign, exclusive paw-print fog mode and daily date-seeded puzzles.

## Nonogram (Picture Logic)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/nonogram/
Paint-by-number logic puzzles: clue numbers give the run lengths of filled cells in each row and column, and a hidden picture emerges when every line is true. Every level reveals a picture (cats throughout), boards are verified single-solution, Easy/Medium are pure line-logic solvable, with a 4-step tutorial, an 11-level campaign and daily date-seeded puzzles.

## Nurikabe (Islands and Sea)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/nurikabe/
Grow numbered islands out of a connected sea: each clue is the exact size of its island, every island holds exactly one clue, the sea must stay connected and may never contain a 2×2 square. Every board is solver-verified single-solution, with a 4-step tutorial, an 11-level campaign from 5×5 to 7×7 and daily date-seeded puzzles.

## Pictomino (Spatial Reasoning)
Play at https://gridpaw.com/pictomino/
A spatial reasoning puzzle game for kids. Drag and rotate puzzle pieces to fill the grid. Multiple difficulty levels from 3x3 to 5x5.

## Features
- Free to play, no registration required
- Works on desktop, tablet, and phone
- Daily challenges with streak tracking
- Multiple difficulty levels
- Cat-themed visuals throughout

## Contact
Website: https://gridpaw.com
